text: We have at ze moment a family Americaine who learn of my husband Frainch—” Here the poodle growled at Dr. Byram and was promptly cuffed by his mistress. “Veux tu!” she cried, with a slap, “veux tu! le vilain, oh! le vilain!” “Mais, madame,” said Hastings, smiling, “il n’a pas l’air très féroce.” The poodle fled, and his mistress cried, “Ah, ze accent charming! He does spik already Frainch like a Parisien young gentleman!” Then Dr. Byram managed to get in a word or two and gathered more or less information with regard to prices.
